text: Session Trash（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DSH 会话提供可恢复的本地回收站。它在会话菜单加入“移到回收站”入口，并在设置页管理回收站；移动会话及其子 agent 会话日志，保留归档和置顶状态以便恢复。用户可查看条目、取消待处理移动、恢复会话或二次确认后永久删除。当前面向默认 JSONL 存储，Windows 不支持；无需 API 密钥或外部服务。

Session Trash (DSH plugin, Web client): adds a local trash for DSH sessions. Move logs from a session menu, then restore or permanently delete them in Settings. Subagent logs move with their parent. It uses JSONL storage, does not support Windows, and needs no API key or external service.
想把误删的 DSH 会话先放进回收站，以后还能恢复。
怎么从会话列表移走旧对话，但保留找回的机会？
给 DSH 会话加一个单独的回收站管理页面。
我想永久删除本地会话日志前再确认一次。
I want to restore a DSH conversation after removing it from the session list.
How can I review and permanently delete trashed session logs?
会话还在运行时怎么避免直接删掉它？
重启 DSH 后自动完成之前排队的会话移动。
Session Trash 的功能「移动会话」：在会话侧边菜单选择“移到回收站”并确认；插件隐藏会话并移动本地日志，包含子 agent 会话。
Session Trash 的功能「恢复会话」：在设置中的 Session trash 页面选择条目恢复；日志返回会话存储，并恢复原有归档和置顶状态。
Session Trash 的功能「永久删除」：在回收站页面确认永久删除条目；插件清理其会话日志并从工作区注册表移除关联状态。
Session Trash 的功能「处理待移动会话」：当前 DSH 持有会话时，移动请求先将其隐藏并记为待处理；下次启动时尝试完成，也可在页面取消。

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · dsh-plugin-session-trash · Session Trash：English | [中文](README.zh.md)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that adds **Move to trash** to each session's sidebar menu. Sessions are not deleted outright: they go to a trash, where you can **restore** them from Settings → Session trash, or **delete them permanently after a second confirmation**. The trash is never emptied automatically.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · dsh-plugin-session-trash · Session Trash：- DSH 0.2.x (`engines.dsh: >=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`, including the 0.2.1-alpha previews)
- macOS and Linux; on Windows the plugin disables itself (the session write lock cannot be checked there)
- The official JSONL session storage only (the DSH default)

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Install：**Desktop**: open **Plugins** in the sidebar → **Add plugin**, enter one of the following, choose **Install**, then **Enable now** (a new plugin starts switched off):

- the GitHub address `https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash`, or `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-session-trash#v0.2.1` for a fixed version
- the npm package name `dsh-plugin-session-trash`
- the absolute path of a local package such as `/path/to/dsh-plugin-session-trash-0.2.1.tgz` (made by `pnpm pack`)

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Install：The repository includes the built `lib/`, so a GitHub install runs no build script. If DSH cannot reach GitHub, use a network that can; the npm mirror DSH offers serves npm packages, not GitHub repositories.

Do not enter the source checkout: its `node_modules` holds development copies of DSH packages that would shadow the ones DSH runs.

**Command line** (optional): install Desktop's own `dsh` command from the application menu **Manage dsh Command…**, quit DSH completely, then run:

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-session-trash
```

**Remove** it from the **Plugins** page, or quit DSH and run `dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-plugin-session-trash`. Sessions in the trash stay in `~/.dsh/session-trash/`; removing the plugin does not delete them.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Safety：| Rule | Detail |
|---|---|
| Sessions in use are never moved | Running work (a turn, subagents, background jobs, schedules) refuses the move; so does a session another DSH process writes (its `session.lock` is held) |
| Opened sessions move at the next start | An idle session opened in this run is hidden at once (the official archive) and moves into the trash at the next DSH start, before any session opens; every check still applies then, and a move that cannot run waits for the following start. You can cancel it on the trash page meanwhile |
| Move, never copy | Moving to and from the trash is a same-volume `rename`; a trash on another volume refuses |
| No recursive removal | Permanent deletion unlinks only the files DSH writes in a session directory (log generations, publish temporaries, `session.lock`) and removes directories with non-recursive `rmdir`; any other file refuses the whole deletion |
| Path checks | Entry ids must be UUIDs; session directories and their parents must be plain directories (no symbolic links) that resolve inside the session root; the trash must not be inside the session root |

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Safety：Subagent sessions move and restore with their parent; forks are independent conversations and stay. Project folders and workspace files are never touched.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Configuration：| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `trashDirectory` | `<DSH home>/session-trash` | Trash directory; outside the session root and on the same volume |
dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Permanent deletion is local only：**Delete permanently** removes the copies on this machine. It cannot reach what DSH has already sent to DeepSeek:

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Permanent deletion is local only：- With the official DeepSeek API, DSH uploads the session log along with each request by default (the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-log-deepseek` plugin). Turning off **Settings → General → Upload Session Log when using the official model API** stops later uploads only; turning it back on also uploads what was recorded while it was off.
- Images sent to the official API are uploaded as files that DSH asks DeepSeek to expire after 7 days; DSH does not guarantee their remote deletion.
dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Permanent deletion is local only：This plugin makes no network requests and sends nothing anywhere.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Known limitations：- A session opened in this run moves into the trash only at the next DSH start (a plugin cannot safely release the write ownership DSH holds); until then it is hidden.
- Only session log directories are handled; attachments, caches, and spill files other features keep for a session stay where they are (see the Attachment Library below for attachment usage).
- Relies on the DSH 0.2.x JSONL directory layout; re-verify after a DSH major upgrade.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Related plugin：**[Attachment Library · dsh-plugin-attachment-library](https://github.com/ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library)**: Session Trash handles session logs only; the images and files attached in conversations stay on this machine. Attachment Library is a read-only page (Settings → Attachment Library) that lists how much space every attachment takes and which conversations still use it, including those in the trash, and can show a file in Finder or open an image in Preview. With both plugins installed, the library counts conversations in the trash too.
dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Related plugin：Install: in **Plugins → Add plugin**, enter `github:ZZZZZZZ-ZZZZZ/dsh-attachment-library#v0.4.1`.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Develop：```sh
pnpm install
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm test        # builds lib/ then runs every test
```

`lib/` is committed so a GitHub install can use it directly; after changing sources run `pnpm run build` and commit `lib/` with them.

dsh-plugin-session-trash README · Develop：The client tests render the real 0.2.0-rc.2 UI components from unmodified MIT-licensed source copies in `tests/vendor/ui-primitives` (tag `dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2`; see `tests/primitives-shim.ts`), because the published component build only runs inside the DSH page; no DSH source checkout is needed. Tests run against the DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 packages published on npm: real JSONL session storage, the real Workspace registry, and the real Typert gateway, with sessions generated in temporary directories.
